title: Delegated task
description: The state of one child task of a delegation batch, carried whole on every delegated_task event (each transition is a fresh snapshot). Read from DelegatedTask (web/src/assistant/delegationContract.ts, validDelegatedTask). Open: validDelegatedTask accepts a member it does not name. The model asks for a batch with the host tool delegate_tasks; the adapter emits delegation_requested and pauses; the host's coordinator (web/src/assistant/delegation.ts, withDelegation) runs the children on the same engine and emits these events. Its shared limits are budget.json $defs/deskLimits (MAX_TOOLS, MAX_CHILD_MODELS, MAX_CHILD_TOOLS, CHILD_TIMEOUT, RESULT_LIMIT, and the agent-run cap and retry in that definition's description).

modelRequests.description: Model requests this child spent; at most six are admitted per child.

toolCalls.description: Tool calls this child made; at most six are admitted per child.

attempts.description: Agent-capability attempts; a second and third only after a busy, not-started admission refusal.

result.description: The child's findings: unverified working material for the parent.

time.description: An ISO 8601 time as toISOString writes it; the reader accepts at most 64 characters that Date.parse reads.

request.description: What the model asks for with delegate_tasks, carried on the delegation_requested event (DelegationRequest). Closed: readDelegationRequest refuses a member it does not name, here and in each task. One batch of one to three tasks per response.

context.description: The only context the child receives; may be empty.

profile.description: An offered profile's id; the Desk offers analyze, review and research.
A task profile (TaskProfile): what a child is told and which host-tool capabilities it may use. A host tool reaches a child only where its own delegation member names a capability the profile lists.
